responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE control-flow-redundancy hardening pass enabled by -fharden-control-flow-redundancy. The pass instruments functions with per-basic-block visitation state and emits verification checks at returns, selected noreturn and sibling/returning-call sites, and exception-related exits so that executed paths can be validated against CFG predecessor/successor relationships; it also contains the option gating, unsupported-function diagnostics, CFG scanning for tail-call-like exits, and the SSA/CFG update hooks needed after inserting the hardening code.
